# UPAY3FOOD

> You pay three times for delivery food in Brazil: the food, the fees, and the difference to the cheapest option. UPAY3FOOD computes all three, plus price per litre / per 100 g of meat, menu rankings and an estimated recommendation with a link to the item.

## MCP server

- URL (Streamable HTTP, stateless, no auth): https://upay3food.com/api/mcp
- Tools: price_breakdown, item_cost, rank_menu, advise, parse_ifood_link, methodology
- Amounts in BRL (reais). Nothing is stored; the server never fetches any platform.

## Rules for agents

- Read only what the user can see (iFood shop pages work without login).
- Never place orders or pay. Menu results are estimates; the bag confirms.
- Do not send cookies, tokens, addresses or personal data.

## Docs

- Methodology: https://docs.upay3food.com/docs/05-architecture/price-calculations
- Agents: https://docs.upay3food.com/docs/05-architecture/agents
- Install the browser extension: https://upay3food.com/instalar
